headline.title: Mira Murati Wants Her AI to ‘Keep Humans in the Loop’
headline.summary: Mira Murati, founder of the Thinking Machines Lab and former CTO of OpenAI, emphasizes her commitment to developing AI that collaborates with humans rather than replacing them. In a recent interview, she articulated her vision of keeping humans involved in the decision-making process.

articles.title: How Chinese short dramas became AI content machines
articles.summary: Chinese short dramas are increasingly utilizing AI technology to streamline content creation, allowing for rapid production and distribution of engaging narratives. This trend highlights the intersection of entertainment and artificial intelligence, as creators leverage AI tools to enhance storytelling and audience engagement.

articles.title: High-Rate Quantized Matrix Multiplication II
articles.summary: The article presents the second part of a study on quantized matrix multiplication, focusing on scenarios where the covariance matrix of the second factor's columns is known. This work is particularly relevant for weight-only post-training quantization in large language models (LLMs).

articles.title: Sea's View on the Future of Agentic Software Development with Codex
articles.summary: Sea Limited's Chief Product Officer announced the company's strategy to implement Codex within its engineering teams to enhance AI-native software development across Asia. This initiative aims to streamline the software creation process and improve efficiency in the region's tech landscape.

articles.title: The Real Losers of the Musk v. Altman Trial
articles.summary: A federal jury is currently deliberating in Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO Sam Altman, with the trial revealing negative implications for all parties involved. The proceedings have highlighted various issues within the tech industry, leading to a perception of diminished reputations for Musk, Altman, and OpenAI.

articles.title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
articles.summary: The article discusses Ego2World, a new approach that compiles egocentric cooking videos into executable environments for embodied agents to enhance belief-state planning in household settings. This method addresses limitations in existing benchmarks by integrating realistic human activities with interactive simulations, aiming to bridge the sim-to-real gap.

articles.title: 3D Primitives are a Spatial Language for VLMs
articles.summary: A recent study highlights the effectiveness of 3D geometric primitives as an intermediate representation for vision-language models (VLMs), enabling them to accurately reconstruct 3D scenes from executable code. Despite this capability, VLMs still struggle with simpler spatial questions related to the same images.

articles.title: Controlling Logical Collapse in LLMs via Algebraic Ontology Projection over F2
articles.summary: The article presents a method called Algebraic Ontology Projection (AOP) that projects the hidden states of large language models into the Galois Field F2, utilizing 42 relational pairs as algebraic keys. AOP demonstrates a zero-shot inclusion accuracy of up to 93.33% on unseen concept pairs, indicating its effectiveness in encoding ontological relations within LLMs.

articles.title: Neural QAOA$^{2}$: Differentiable Joint Graph Partitioning and Parameter Initialization for Quantum Combinatorial Optimization
articles.summary: The article introduces Neural QAOA², a method designed to enhance the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for combinatorial optimization by addressing limitations in graph partitioning and parameter initialization. This approach aims to improve the alignment between partitioning metrics and quantum optimization goals, thereby increasing scalability and efficiency in quantum computing applications.

articles.title: Context Matters: Auditing Gender Bias in T2I Generation through Risk-Tiered Use-Case Profiles
articles.summary: The article discusses the need for auditing gender bias in text-to-image (T2I) generative models, which are increasingly used in various sectors. It highlights the potential for these models to reinforce stereotypes and suggests the development of risk-tiered use-case profiles to better understand and mitigate these biases.

articles.title: LeanSearch v2: Global Premise Retrieval for Lean 4 Theorem Proving
articles.summary: LeanSearch v2 introduces a new tool for global premise retrieval in Lean 4 theorem proving, addressing the challenge of identifying a comprehensive set of library lemmas needed for concise proofs. Unlike existing semantic search engines and premise-selection systems, LeanSearch v2 aims to recover the complete set of premises required for an entire theorem.

articles.title: EvObj: Learning Evolving Object-centric Representations for 3D Instance Segmentation without Scene Supervision
articles.summary: EvObj is a new approach for unsupervised 3D instance segmentation that aims to reduce the geometric discrepancies between synthetic training data and real-world point clouds. By incorporating two innovative modules, it effectively addresses challenges related to morphological variations and occlusion artifacts in transferring object priors from synthetic datasets to real scans.
